versions.changelog: v1.1.0: 集成 Qwen3-TTS 作为首选 TTS（6角色音色库），失败回退 Edge TTS

Initial release — Transform picture book scripts into bilingual (Chinese/English) narrated videos, ready for Douyin publishing.

- End-to-end automated pipeline: script parsing, storyboard creation, image generation, narration (TTS), subtitles (ASS), video composition.
- Outputs two video versions (Chinese and English), each with subtitles, narration, and cover.
- Step-by-step user confirmation for storyboard and style selection; blocking phases to ensure workflow order.
- Generates Douyin-ready titles, descriptions, and hashtags for both languages.
- Integrates with related skills for image generation (ComfyUI), TTS, and video publishing.
